# Tessellate

> Deterministic UI composition engine and interface intelligence platform. Composes coherent web interfaces from an open, validated resource vocabulary using 10-dimensional Design DNA vectors.

Tessellate does not sell a pile of disconnected components. It understands product topology, matches components using semantic layout grammars, normalises disparate source files into a unified token system, and allows humans and agents to export production-ready React + Tailwind CSS code without framework lock-in.

## Documentation & Machine Endpoints

- Full Documentation for Agents: https://tessellate.design/llms-full.txt
- Complete Catalog JSON: https://tessellate.design/data/catalog.json
- Minified Catalog JSON: https://tessellate.design/data/catalog.min.json
- OpenAPI Specification: https://tessellate.design/openapi.json
- Shadcn Registry Index: https://tessellate.design/r/index.json
- Individual Resource Schema: https://tessellate.design/r/{slug}.json

## Core Principles

1. **Deterministic Composition**: Mathematical compatibility scoring and layout grammars guarantee coherent results without mandatory LLM hallucinations.
2. **10-Dimensional Design DNA**: Every resource and project specifies a 10D vector:
   - Density: compact | regular | comfortable | dense
   - Chroma: monochrome | minimal | nuanced | vibrant | expressive
   - Contrast: soft | normal | high | max
   - Radii: sharp | subtle | rounded | pill
   - Depth: flat | border | shadow | layered
   - Motion: none | subtle | functional | expressive
   - Scale: major-second | minor-third | major-third | perfect-fourth | golden
   - Pattern: none | dots | grid | mesh
   - Glass: none | subtle | heavy
   - Color Mode: dark | light | system
3. **Guest-First Architecture**: Core browsing, composition, editing, audit, and export operate 100% in-browser with zero mandatory account barrier.
4. **Agent-Native Distribution**: Native shadcn-compatible registry endpoints and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for direct IDE/agent integration.

## Installation & Distribution

### Shadcn CLI
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://tessellate.design/r/button-primary.json
```

### Tessellate CLI (@tessellate/cli)
```bash
# Install CLI
npm install -g @tessellate/cli

# Initialize project with Tessellate design tokens
tess init

# Search component catalog
tess search "hero bold"

# Add resource to local project
tess add button-primary

# Validate manifest
tess validate project.json

# Export composed manifest to React + Tailwind
tess export project.json --output ./src
```

### Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Run the Tessellate MCP server locally for Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, or Antigravity:
```bash
npx @tessellate/mcp
```

Tools provided:
- `search_resources`: Search resources by query, category, and DNA vectors.
- `get_resource`: Retrieve complete manifest for a resource.
- `get_resource_code`: Retrieve raw TSX component code.
- `get_resource_metadata`: Retrieve slots, dependencies, and WCAG accessibility ratings.
- `find_alternatives`: Discover structurally compatible substitutes.
- `recommend_resources`: Proactively recommend resources based on page intent.
- `compose_screen`: Deterministically generate a `ProjectManifest` from grammar and intent.
- `validate_project`: Validate a `ProjectManifest` against canonical schemas.
- `audit_project`: Audit contrast, motion, performance, and token coherence.
- `get_design_dna`: Inspect Design DNA presets and vectors.
- `list_design_directions`: Return visual reference directions (Editorial Precision, Kinetic Monolith, Atmospheric Depth).

## Resources in Catalogue (44)

- [Accordion](https://tessellate.design/r/accordion): Collapsible vertically stacked disclosure panels with rotating chevron animations. (primitives, layout)
- [Alert Dialog](https://tessellate.design/r/alert-dialog): Destructive confirmation modal requiring explicit acknowledgment or cancellation before proceeding. (primitives, overlays, feedback)
- [Autocomplete](https://tessellate.design/r/autocomplete): Typeahead prediction control suggesting options inline or in a floating palette. (primitives, inputs)
- [Avatar](https://tessellate.design/r/avatar): Circular user representation displaying profile photography with monogram initial fallback and presence dot. (primitives, display)
- [Avatar Group](https://tessellate.design/r/avatar-group): Overlapping clustered avatars with ring separation and excess counter pill (+N). (primitives, display)
- [Badge](https://tessellate.design/r/badge): Compact pill indicator for counts, status dots, and metadata taxonomy tags. (primitives, display)
- [Bottom Sheet](https://tessellate.design/r/bottom-sheet): Mobile-first bottom sliding sheet with drag handle bar and responsive snap points. (primitives, overlays)
- [Breadcrumb](https://tessellate.design/r/breadcrumb): Hierarchical navigation trail path with customizable separators and accessible current page. (primitives, navigation)
- [Button](https://tessellate.design/r/button): Tactile, accessible multi-intent button primitive with Quiet, Expressive, and Nocturne curated configurations. (primitives, inputs, actions)
- [Button Group](https://tessellate.design/r/button-group): Connected cluster of action buttons with cohesive outer border and seamless seams. (primitives, inputs, actions)
- [Checkbox](https://tessellate.design/r/checkbox): Accessible boolean selection control with indeterminate state, animated checkmark, and descriptive label. (primitives, inputs)
- [Combobox](https://tessellate.design/r/combobox): Searchable selection input combining text filtering with item picker dropdown. (primitives, inputs)
- [Command Menu](https://tessellate.design/r/command-menu): ⌘K spotlight dialog modal with quick command search, group categories, and keyboard arrow navigation. (primitives, overlays, search)
- [Context Menu](https://tessellate.design/r/context-menu): Right-click action palette anchored directly to the user pointer coordinates. (primitives, overlays)
- [Dialog](https://tessellate.design/r/dialog): Accessible modal dialog window with backdrop scrim, focus trapping, and header/footer slots. (primitives, overlays)
- [Disclosure](https://tessellate.design/r/disclosure): Single collapsible toggle container with summary header and expandable details. (primitives, layout)
- [Drawer](https://tessellate.design/r/drawer): Slide-out side panel for contextual inspections, property editing, or complex drilldowns. (primitives, overlays, layout)
- [Dropdown Menu](https://tessellate.design/r/dropdown-menu): Floating contextual menu with item hover states, shortcut indicators, and dividers. (primitives, overlays, navigation)
- [Icon Button](https://tessellate.design/r/icon-button): Compact icon-only action trigger with tooltip support and accessible label semantics. (primitives, inputs, actions)
- [Inline Alert](https://tessellate.design/r/inline-alert): In-page contextual message banner conveying informational, success, warning, or danger states. (primitives, feedback)
- [Text Input](https://tessellate.design/r/input): Clean, accessible single-line text input with label, helper copy, and error states. (primitives, inputs)
- [Link](https://tessellate.design/r/link): Accessible semantic anchor navigation primitive with tactile underline animation and external indicators. (primitives, navigation)
- [Multi-select](https://tessellate.design/r/multi-select): Tag-based selection input allowing multiple choices with removable pills. (primitives, inputs)
- [Number Input](https://tessellate.design/r/number-input): Stepper input control with increment/decrement buttons, min/max bounds, and unit suffix. (primitives, inputs)
- [Pagination](https://tessellate.design/r/pagination): Page traversal bar with previous/next triggers, page numbering, and ellipsis jumps. (primitives, navigation)
- [Password Input](https://tessellate.design/r/password-input): Masked credential field with toggleable eye icon and password strength meter. (primitives, inputs, auth)
- [Popover](https://tessellate.design/r/popover): Floating rich content card anchored to a target trigger with dismissal handling. (primitives, overlays)
- [Progress Bar](https://tessellate.design/r/progress-bar): Linear progress meter with determinate percentage progress and indeterminate pulse. (primitives, feedback)
- [Progress Ring](https://tessellate.design/r/progress-ring): Circular radial progress meter with smooth stroke animation and central metric label. (primitives, feedback)
- [Radio Group](https://tessellate.design/r/radio-group): Accessible single-choice selection group with circle indicators and keyboard navigation. (primitives, inputs)
- [Range Slider](https://tessellate.design/r/range-slider): Dual-thumb interval selector for bounding min/max numerical thresholds simultaneously. (primitives, inputs)
- [Search Input](https://tessellate.design/r/search-input): High-visibility search field with magnifying glass icon, keyboard shortcut badge (⌘K), and instant clear. (primitives, inputs, search)
- [Segmented Control](https://tessellate.design/r/segmented-control): High-density toggle bar with active sliding pill indicator between mutual modes. (primitives, inputs)
- [Select](https://tessellate.design/r/select): Accessible styled dropdown selector with trigger, chevron indicator, and options. (primitives, inputs)
- [Separator](https://tessellate.design/r/separator): Clean hairline divider line supporting horizontal and vertical orientations and middle labels. (primitives, layout)
- [Skeleton](https://tessellate.design/r/skeleton): Content placeholder animation primitive preventing layout shift during loading. (primitives, feedback)
- [Slider](https://tessellate.design/r/slider): Smooth continuous value slider with track, fill, and precision drag thumb. (primitives, inputs)
- [Split Button](https://tessellate.design/r/split-button): Dual-action trigger combining primary immediate intent with secondary dropdown alternatives. (primitives, inputs, actions)
- [Switch](https://tessellate.design/r/switch): Accessible sliding toggle switch for boolean preferences and instant settings. (primitives, inputs)
- [Tabs](https://tessellate.design/r/tabs): Accessible tabbed navigation system with active underlined or pill indicators and panels. (primitives, navigation)
- [Tag Chip](https://tessellate.design/r/tag-chip): Clickable and removable categorical chip token for multi-criteria filters. (primitives, inputs)
- [Textarea](https://tessellate.design/r/textarea): Multi-line text input primitive with character counter, accessible label, and auto-expand support. (primitives, inputs)
- [Toast](https://tessellate.design/r/toast): Ephemeral floating notification banner with auto-dismiss timers and action hooks. (primitives, feedback)
- [Tooltip](https://tessellate.design/r/tooltip): Micro-interaction popup providing contextual hints on hover or keyboard focus. (primitives, feedback)

---

## Semantic Token Contract

All Tessellate resources conform to the unified CSS variable contract:

### Colors
- `--tess-canvas`: Base background canvas color.
- `--tess-surface`: Primary card and container surface.
- `--tess-surface-raised`: Elevated container surface.
- `--tess-surface-overlay`: Modal and dialog overlay surface.
- `--tess-border`: Subtle dividing borders.
- `--tess-border-strong`: Prominent interactive borders.
- `--tess-ink`: High-contrast body text.
- `--tess-ink-secondary`: Supporting label and meta text.
- `--tess-ink-tertiary`: Placeholder and disabled text.
- `--tess-cobalt`: Primary accent / brand interactive color.
- `--tess-cobalt-hover`: Hover accent state.
- `--tess-focus-ring`: High-visibility focus indicator (minimum 3:1 contrast against background).

### Spacing & Metrics
- `--tess-radius`: Border radius derived from DNA Radii dimension.
- `--tess-space-unit`: Base spacing scale unit (derived from Density dimension).
- `--tess-font-sans`: Primary sans-serif font family.
- `--tess-font-mono`: Monospace tabular figures font family.
